notes.title: Beta 1.1.7
notes.content:
Increased campfire fuel capacity.

[b]Added bowl item[/b]

You can store and use water with the bowl.

Added blood effect.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.5
notes.content:
[b]Log:[/b]

The material that comes out when we cut down trees.

It can be used in building construction and obtaining wood.

[b]New Sounds[/b]

Added zombie grunting and cafting sounds

[b]Hud on/off button[/b]

You can now turn the Hud display on or off from the settings.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.2
notes.content:
[b]-The bug during the attack has been fixed.[/b]

You will no longer run out of energy when you press the attack button before the attack animation ends.

[b]Color feature has been added to the text under the crosshair.[/b]

If it is white, the structure you are looking at can be broken with the item we have. 
If it is red, it cannot be broken. 
If it is yellow, the item it will drop depends on the type of item you use.

[b]Added wooden pillar[/b]

Added wooden pillar as structure.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
[b]-Fall damage added[/b]
If you fall from a certain height, you will take fall damage.

[b]-Flame effect added[/b]
Living things on something that burns burn.

[b]-Bush seed added[/b]
You can grow new bushes by planting the seeds from the bushes.

[b]-Door added[/b]
You can now build a door.

[b]-Construction system has been renewed[/b]
Building materials can stick together better.

notes.title: Beta 1.1 update
notes.content:
Beta 1.1 update

The graphics engine was switched to Unreal Engine 5.

Temperature system and maps updated

Save system has been updated.
